mentions.name: ccode
mentions.description: A small launcher CLI for Claude Code that simplifies switching between different AI providers and configurations. It manages a config file (init/edit-config), launches default or per-provider profiles (e.g. DeepSeek API, OpenRouter models and presets), supports Remote Control sessions that appear in the web/desktop app, and can override default permissions. Source available with pre-built binaries distributed on itch.io under a pay-what-you-want model, and the Mac build is now code-signed. Planned feature: an Anthropic API to OpenAI API proxy so providers without direct Anthropic API support can be used, with dynamic model switching mid-session via a local endpoint.
mentions.problem: Makes it easier to switch Claude Code between providers and configurations, e.g. keeping a subscription usable after downgrading from Max to Pro while also running sessions with less expensive or local models.
